NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DEFEND.title: Defend
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_DANCE.title: Sakura Dance
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_DANCE.descript: When you draw this card, [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost and rightmost Orbs.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_STRIKE.title: Strike
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_EMERGENCY_PLATING.des:
Gain {EmergencyPlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold] this turn.
Trigger your [gold]Plating[/gold] once.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ROLLING_BARRAGE.title: Rolling Barrage
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ROLLING_BARRAGE.descr:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each stack of your [gold]temporary Powers[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD.title: Targeted Reload
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD.descr: Choose an Orb. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and load a random shell.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_NAVY_HOLIDAY.title: Naval Holiday
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SACRED_TREE.title: Sacred Tree
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SACRED_TREE.descripti: Whenever you draw this card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Repeatedly trigger your [gold]Plating[/gold] until you have none.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_BATTLE_DISPOSITION.de: Rearrange the cards in your draw pile.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_BATTLE_DISPOSITION.se: Drag cards to reorder, or select two cards in sequence to swap their positions.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_CONCENTRATED_FIRE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [gold]Focus[/gold] equal to your stacks of {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]temporary Powers[/gold]|temporary [gold]Focus[/gold]} this turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DECISIVE_BATTLE.title: Decisive Battle
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DECISIVE_BATTLE.descr:
[gold]Evoke[/gold] Orbs equal to the number of Orbs you have [gold]Evoked[/gold] this combat.{InCombat:
([gold]Evoke[/gold] {CalculatedEvokes:diff()} Orbs)|}
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.title: Fate's Return
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.descript:
Choose a card in your exhaust pile other than Fate's Return. Put it on top of your draw pile.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.selectio: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FLEET_REGROUP.title: Fleet Regroup
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FLEET_REGROUP.descrip: At the end of your turn, you may choose any number of cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your draw pile.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_REINCARNATIONS_END.de:
Draw until your hand is full.
At the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_FORM.title: Sakura Form
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_FORM.descripti: After the first 3 cards you play from your hand each turn, choose any number of cards in your hand. Shuffle them into your draw pile, then draw that many cards.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SALVO_FIRE.title: Salvo Fire
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SALVO_FIRE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, [gold]Evoke[/gold] all your [gold]High-Explosive Shells[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_KAGURA.title: Sakura Kagura
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_KAGURA.descrip: When you draw this card, [gold]Evoke[/gold] all your Orbs.
